title: Spatial Frequency Modulation for Semantic Segmentation (SFM)
mechanism: Adaptive resampling densely samples high-frequency areas before strided downsampling so they are not aliased, and multi-scale adaptive upsampling demodulates them back in the decoder.
adaptation: A 1 to 2 px crack is pure high frequency and is aliased by ResNet-34 conv1 stride 2, the maxpool and each stride-2 block. Insert ARS before conv1 stride and the layer2 downsample, MSAU in the last two U-Net++ decoder nodes; port the modules out of mmseg by hand (no install).
min_experiment: Arm house PF + SFM vs house PF; 5-fold CV crack IoU, relF1@2, crack components >= 20 px found, gridline IoU. Kill: gridline IoU < +0.03 and crack IoU n.d. About 10 GPU-h.
prior_overlap: None: 2x input (R5) added pixels but not anti-aliased sampling; no frequency-aware module was run.
evidence: R: +1.5 mIoU Mask2Former-Swin-T, +1.4 InternImage-T on ADE20K, +0.8 on Cityscapes for deformable conv.

alt_notes.adaptation: Dense resampling around cracks and finger breaks before strides; heavier follow-up to Seg-Aliasing, only if that shows a signal.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + SFM; baseline house; kill if crack IoU < +0.012 and E1 relF1@2 < +0.02.
